node: High-end MLCCs for AI server boards and rack-scale accelerator systems
summary: Expanded the US-tradable universe around the high-end AI-server MLCC node. The strongest direct evidence points to Japanese and Korean MLCC leaders, but the US-accessible underfollowed lane is mostly OTC ADRs plus one NYSE-listed passive-component supplier with weaker AI-server qualification evidence. The node remains a narrow-product-mix bottleneck hypothesis: AI servers require materially more MLCCs than general-purpose servers, but later layers must separate generic ceramic-capacitor revenue from small, high-capacitance, low-ESR/low-ESL AI-server-qualified parts.
